_comment: Compile-time differences from the retail of the same version that are known and not fixed yet. Each says why. toolchain_parity.py fails on an undeclared difference and on a declaration that no longer matches one.

exceptions.why: No PGO yet: the retail uses Mozilla's own training profile (merged.profdata). Whether a page can time the difference is to be measured on the same machine before PGO is built (2026-10-27).
Part of PGO: the startup order of omni.ja. Goes with --enable-profile-use.
No cross-language LTO yet; Mozilla turns it on together with PGO. Same measurement as --enable-profile-use.
